60710-the-geology-of-groton-state-forest.title: The Geology Of Groton State Forest
60710-the-geology-of-groton-state-forest.creator: Unknown
60710-the-geology-of-groton-state-forest.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. State Forest is a gray to white, medium-grained rock with the mineral grains all about the same size. Surfaces exposed to weathering are generally darker in color and frequently are covered with scales of dark colored lichen. If the rock is broken to reveal an unaltered surface close examination will disclose individual mineral grains of mica, feldspar and quartz.

62447-leaves-from-st-john-chrysostom.title: Leaves From St John Chrysostom
62447-leaves-from-st-john-chrysostom.creator: Unknown
62447-leaves-from-st-john-chrysostom.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. John of Antioch was born about the year 347, of a noble family. His father, Secundus, held a high rank in the imperial army; he died early, and left a very young widow, in the bloom of age and beauty, and amply endowed with wealth. Many suitors sought to obtain the hand of St. She remained faithful to the memory of her husband, and devoted to the education of her only son.

arxiv-1706-03187.title: Self-gravitational solitary waves in astrophysical compact objects
arxiv-1706-03187.creator: A. A. Mamun
arxiv-1706-03187.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by A. A. Mamun. The condition for the existence of self-gravitational solitary waves (SGSWs), and their polarity in any astrophysical compact object are theoretically found for the first time. The pseudo-potential approach, which is valid for arbitrary amplitude SGSWs, is emplyed. The general analytical results are applied in white dwarfs and neutron stars to identify the basic features (polarity, amplitude, and width) of the SGSWs formed in them.

arxiv-2012-01610.title: Structure of wavefunction for interacting bosons in mean-field with random k k -body interactions

arxiv-2012-01610.description: Abstract Wavefunction structure is analyzed for dense interacting many-boson systems using Hamiltonian H H , which is a sum of one-body h ⁡ ( 1 ) h(1) and an embedded GOE of k k -body interaction V ⁡ ( k ) V(k) with strength λ \lambda .

arxiv-2210-00558.title: Stochastic Resetting for Enhanced Sampling
arxiv-2210-00558.creator: Ofir Blumer, Shlomi Reuveni, Barak Hirshberg
arxiv-2210-00558.description: Abstract We present a method for enhanced sampling of molecular dynamics simulations using stochastic resetting. Various phenomena, ranging from crystal nucleation to protein folding, occur on timescales that are unreachable in standard simulations. arxiv-2303-15193.description: Abstract . arxiv-2305-12222.title: AI-assisted super-resolution cosmological simulations III: Time evolution 2022
arxiv-2305-12222.creator: Xiaowen Zhang, Patrick Lachance, Yueying Ni, Yin Li, Rupert A. C. Croft, Tiziana Di Matteo, Simeon Bird, Yu Feng
arxiv-2305-12222.description: Abstract In this work, we extend our recently developed super-resolution (SR) model for cosmological simulations to produce fully time-consistent evolving representations of the particle phase-space distribution. We employ a style-based constrained generative adversarial network (Style-GAN) where the changing cosmic time is an input style parameter to the network.

arxiv-2305-15490.title: Symplectic model reduction of Hamiltonian systems using data-driven quadratic manifolds
arxiv-2305-15490.creator: Harsh Sharma, Hongliang Mu, Patrick Buchfink, Rudy Geelen, Silke Glas, Boris Kramer
arxiv-2305-15490.description: Abstract This work presents two novel approaches for the symplectic model reduction of high-dimensional Hamiltonian systems using data-driven quadratic manifolds. Classical symplectic model reduction approaches employ linear symplectic subspaces for representing the high-dimensional system states in a reduced-dimensional coordinate system.

arxiv-2401-04187.title: Asymptotics of the Minimal Feedback Arc Set in Erdős-Rényi Graphs
arxiv-2401-04187.creator: Harvey Diamond, Mark Kon, Louise Raphael
arxiv-2401-04187.description: Abstract Given a directed graph, the Minimal Feedback Arc Set (FAS) problem asks for a minimal set of arcs which, when removed, results in an acyclic graph. Equivalently, the FAS problem asks to find an ordering of the vertices that minimizes the number of feedback arcs. The FAS problem is considered an algorithmic problem of central importance in discrete mathematics.

arxiv-2405-11835.title: Demo Paper: A Game Agents Battle Driven by Free-Form Text Commands Using Code-Generation LLM
arxiv-2405-11835.creator: Ray Ito, Junichiro Takahashi
arxiv-2405-11835.description: Abstract This paper presents a demonstration of our monster battle game, in which the game agents fight in accordance with their player’s language commands. The commands were translated into the knowledge expression called behavior branches by a code-generation large language model.

arxiv-2407-17880.title: DAM: Towards A Foundation Model for Time Series Forecasting Thanks: Also working at the School of Computer Science, University of St Andrews, UK.
arxiv-2407-17880.creator: Luke Darlow, Qiwen Deng, Ahmed Hassan, Amos Storkey
arxiv-2407-17880.description: Abstract It is challenging to scale time series forecasting models such that they forecast accurately for multiple distinct domains and datasets, all with potentially different underlying collection procedures (e.g., sample resolution), patterns (e.g., periodicity), and prediction requirements (e.g., reconstruction vs. forecasting). We call this general task universal forecasting.

arxiv-2408-10015.title: Deterministic Policy Gradient Primal-Dual Methods for Continuous-Space Constrained MDPs
arxiv-2408-10015.creator: Sergio Rozada, Dongsheng Ding, Antonio G. Marques, Alejandro Ribeiro
arxiv-2408-10015.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sergio Rozada, Dongsheng Ding, Antonio G. Marques, Alejandro Ribeiro. We study the problem of computing deterministic optimal policies for constrained Markov decision processes (MDPs) with continuous state and action spaces, which are widely encountered in constrained dynamical systems. Designing deterministic policy gradient methods in continuous state and action spaces is particularly challenging due to the lack of enumerable state-action pairs and the adoption of deterministic policies, hindering the application of existing policy gradient methods.

arxiv-2505-12220.title: Machine Learning Applications Related to Suicide in Military and Veterans: A Scoping Literature Review
arxiv-2505-12220.creator: Yuhan Zhang, Yishu Wei, Yanshan Wang, Yunyu Xiao, COL (Ret.) Ronald K. Poropatich, Gretchen L. Haas, Yiye Zhang, Chunhua Weng, Jinze Liu, Lisa A. Brenner, James M. Bjork, Yifan Peng
arxiv-2505-12220.description: Abstract Background: Suicide remains one of the main preventable causes of death among active service members and veterans. Early detection and prediction are crucial in suicide prevention. Machine learning techniques have been explored in recent years with a specific focus on the assessment and prediction of multiple suicide-related outcomes, which have yielded promising results.

arxiv-2510-18743.title: Wireless-Fed Pinching-Antenna Systems (Wi-PASS) for NextG Wireless Networks
arxiv-2510-18743.creator: Kasun R. Wijewardhana, Animesh Yadav, Ming Zeng, Mohamed Elsayed, Octavia A. Dobre, Zhiguo Ding
arxiv-2510-18743.description: Abstract Waveguide-based pinching-antenna systems (PASS) have recently emerged as a promising solution to mitigate severe propagation losses in millimeter-wave and terahertz bands by intelligently and flexibly establishing line-of-sight links. However, their reliance on wire-based feeding confines deployment to areas near the base station (BS), limiting installation flexibility and making them cost-ineffective for serving distant users or regions.

arxiv-2602-10433.title: Depth of free-by-cyclic groups
arxiv-2602-10433.creator: Spencer Dowdall, Yassine Guerch, Radhika Gupta
arxiv-2602-10433.description: Abstract For a free group automorphism, we prove that its poset of attracting lamination orbits is a canonical invariant of the associated mapping torus. That is, if a free-by-cyclic group splits as a mapping torus in two different ways, then the corresponding automorphisms have isomorphic posets of lamination orbits.

pmc-10666247.title: In Silico and In Vitro Analyses to Repurpose Quercetin as a Human Pancreatic α-Amylase Inhibitor
pmc-10666247.creator: Bimal
pmc-10666247.description: Human pancreatic α-amylase (HPA), situated at the apex of the starch digestion hierarchy, is an attractive therapeutic approach to precisely regulate blood glucose levels, thereby efficiently managing diabetes. Polyphenols offer a natural and multifaceted approach to moderate postprandial sugar spikes, with their slight modulation in carbohydrate digestion and potential secondary benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.

pmc-11300986.title: Evaluating whether Prostate Cancer UK’s risk checker is a help or hindrance to prostate-specific antigen testing policy: a mixed-methods study
pmc-11300986.creator: Natalia Norori, Chiara de Biase, Yui Hang Wong, Sadie Robson Crabtree, Matt Cox, Esther Appleby, Andrew Seggie, Rachel Brown, Amy Rylance
pmc-11300986.description: BackgroundThe UK has an informed choice testing policy for prostate cancer. The prostate-specific antigen (PSA) blood test is available for free to any man aged ≥50 years who requests it and has been informed of the harms and benefits. This policy leads to differences in PSA testing rates, which can exacerbate health inequalities.

pmc-13217990.title: Pre-use acceptability of telemedicine among nursing students: a quantitative cross-sectional study

pmc-13290991.title: Radiomic Features Extracted from Magnetic Resonance Imaging to Identify Arteriopathy in a Humanized Mouse Model of Sickle Cell Anemia and Sickle Cell Trait
pmc-13290991.creator: Liana Hatoum, Viviana Benfante, Hannah Song Lee, Edward A. Botchwey, Albert Comelli, Manu O. Platt
pmc-13290991.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeSickle cell disease (SCD) is a hereditary blood disorder that increases stroke risk in children. Previously, we showed that SCD caused accelerated arteriopathy in a sickle cell transgenic mouse model compared to sickle cell trait controls. We sought to determine whether radiomics analysis of label-free carotid artery magnetic resonance angiography (MRA) can differentiate between SCD mice (SS) from heterozygous sickle cell trait control mice (AS).

pmc-13453934.title: From ICU Survival to Recovery: A Somalia-Adapted Nurse-Led Home Recovery Framework After Critical Illness in Low-Resource Settings
pmc-13453934.creator: Abdishakur Mohamud Hassan Hidigow
pmc-13453934.description: Survival from critical illness is not equivalent to recovery, particularly in low-resource health systems where ICU survivors may return home with weakness, respiratory vulnerability, medication problems, poor wound care, malnutrition, psychological distress, caregiver burden, and limited follow-up. This commentary responds to the post-ICU care gap in Somalia by proposing a Somalia-adapted nurse-led home recovery framework.
